entities.summary: Dayán Viciedo Pérez is a Cuban professional baseball infielder for the Yokohama DeNA BayStars of Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB). He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Chicago White Sox, and in NPB for the Chunichi Dragons.
